column1: # Provisional game profile (written on Windows from dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)

# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so the guess is a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. The rewriter cuts the allocator in any Unreal 4 / 5 main (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and gives the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py), so an iPhone takes a smaller guest block, as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/reference/memory.md). The iPhone layout is the big one the local rules use (PITFALLS.md rule 7): 7 GB of alias, more than Phantom Breaker's 4.375 GB, since Unreal streams texture pools into it.
